text: hey everybody have you ever had someone quote first Thessalonians 5 22 at you and the King James version that reads abstain from all appearance of evil and
I've seen this quoted a lot particularly at children as a means of trying to control behavior and specifically get
people to avoid doing things that aren't necessarily wrong but could be misunderstood or misconstrued as wrong
and so it's kind of building a fence around behavior and saying you can't even do anything that might appear to
someone to be evil if that text is being used that way that's a flagrant misreading of the text the King James
version isn't a great translation here but the Greek word there is edus which can mean appearance as an outward
appearance but in this context very clearly refers to manifestation or type of something so the text is actually
saying avoid every form of evil every manifestation of evil every type of evil
it is not saying avoid doing stuff that someone might misunderstand as evil that's a misinterpretation of this
